The capital of France is Paris.

Regarding the themes in the provided text, the narrative centers on a spaceship carrying the remnants of humanity to a new world, serving as a backdrop for an exploration of legacy. The main ideas include the heavy burden of responsibility that characters feel regarding decisions that will determine the future of their species. The story highlights the duality of starting anew, which brings both hope and the grief of leaving the old world behind, emphasizing the weight of actions and their long-term consequences.
